description: Gifts for people who love cooking at Black Friday prices: Thermapen ONE £54.60, Ninja knife block £109.99, Le Creuset casserole £186.65 and more.
intro:
**The best gift for someone who loves cooking right now is the Thermapen ONE instant-read thermometer at £54.60, 30% off direct from Thermapen. Best cheap pick: the OXO angled measuring jug at £10.99 on Amazon. Best splurge: a Le Creuset 24cm cast iron casserole at £186.65, below its lowest recorded price.**

Every price below was checked on 23 November 2026 during Black Friday Week, from PriceSpy's live listings or the retailer's own page, so check the product page before you buy. Where another shop is cheaper than Amazon, we say so on the card.

deals.name: OXO Good Grips 1L angled measuring jug
deals.note: Our best cheap pick. The angled scale lets you read the measure from above without bending down, a small thing keen cooks love. Within pennies of its lowest recorded price; offer runs to 30 November.

deals.name: Salter 1035 digital kitchen scale (5kg)
deals.note: Flat, accurate and easy to wipe clean, with an add-and-weigh button for baking. A solid stocking filler for anyone still using an old dial scale. No price history to call it a deal.

deals.name: Le Creuset Signature stoneware storage jar 1.1L (Flame)
deals.note: An easy way to give Le Creuset without spending casserole money. At the bottom of its three-month range (it has been £38). Good for utensils, coffee or sugar.

deals.name: Lodge pre-seasoned cast iron skillet 26cm (L8SK3)
deals.note: A pan that lasts a lifetime and gets better with use; great for steaks, cornbread and going from hob to oven. Not a deal: a specialist knife shop has it at £39.99, so Amazon is a few pounds dearer.

deals.name: Thermapen ONE instant-read thermometer (Charcoal)
deals.note: Reads in about a second and takes the guessing out of roasts, chicken and sugar work. 30% off direct from the maker. Our top pick for the cook who has everything.

deals.name: Ninja Foodi StaySharp 6-piece knife block (K32006UK)
deals.note: Five knives plus a built-in sharpener in the block, so they stay sharp with a quick pull. Below the £149.99 low PriceSpy had recorded. Ignore the £179.99 'was', which it rarely sold at. Offer runs to 30 November.

deals.name: Meater Pro wireless meat thermometer
deals.note: A wire-free probe that sits in the joint and sends the temperature to your phone, ideal for barbecues and Christmas roasts. Currys has some colours at around £99 today, so compare before buying.

deals.name: Ninja CREAMi ice cream maker (NC300UK)
deals.note: Turns frozen bases into ice cream, sorbet or protein ice cream in minutes. The price is falling, but it has been £149.99, so this is fair rather than a low. See our [Ninja Creami guide](/guides/ninja-creami-deals-uk/).

deals.name: Ninja Crispi Pro portable glass air fryer
deals.note: Glass cooking dishes that go from air fryer to table to fridge with lids, so no tipping food between baskets. A thoughtful upgrade for someone with an old plastic-basket air fryer.

deals.name: Le Creuset Signature cast iron round casserole 24cm, 4.2L (Garnet)
deals.note: The gift serious cooks hope for: stews, braises, bread and soups for 4 to 6. Below the £196 low PriceSpy had recorded. Other colours vary in price, so check yours.

deals.name: Ninja Woodfire electric BBQ grill and smoker (OG701UK)
deals.note: An outdoor electric grill that adds real wood-pellet smoke, no gas or charcoal needed. Ninja's own site has had it at £224.99, so check there too before buying.

deals.name: KitchenAid Artisan 5KSM175 stand mixer (Juniper)
deals.note: Our splurge pick for a baker: the 4.8L Artisan with tilt head and a decade-long life. Same price at Currys. Not its lowest ever; see our [KitchenAid guide](/guides/kitchenaid-black-friday-deals-2026/) for target prices.

body:
## Best gifts for people who love cooking at a glance

- **Best overall:** Thermapen ONE thermometer, £54.60 direct from Thermapen
- **Best cheap:** OXO Good Grips angled measuring jug, £10.99 at Amazon
- **Best value upgrade:** Ninja StaySharp knife block, £109.99 at Amazon (a record low)
- **Best splurge:** Le Creuset 24cm casserole, £186.65, or a KitchenAid Artisan mixer, £429, both at Amazon

## How to choose a gift for a keen cook

**Upgrade what they use every day.** Most cooks already own the basics, but many are still using a blunt knife, a wobbly old scale or a thin pan. A better version of an everyday tool gets used every week, which a gadget often doesn't.

**Ask what's missing, not what's new.** A good thermometer is the item most home cooks don't own and every chef does. It ends overcooked chicken and dry turkey, and it's useful for baking, jam and sugar work too. The Thermapen ONE is the one professionals use; a Meater is better for someone who barbecues or roasts and wants to walk away from the oven.

**Check the space.** Stand mixers, smokers and ice cream makers are big. Before buying a KitchenAid, a Woodfire grill or a Creami, make sure there's room on the worktop or in the garden, or it will live in a cupboard.

**Cookware has a long life.** Le Creuset cast iron and a Lodge skillet will outlast the person you buy them for. They're heavy, so for an older cook a 24cm casserole is about as big as it's sensible to go, and the stoneware jar is a lighter way to give the brand.

## What's a good price this week?

Several of these are at or below the lowest prices we've seen recorded: the Le Creuset 24cm casserole under £190, the Ninja StaySharp block at £109.99 and the Le Creuset jar at £28.50. Others, like the KitchenAid Artisan (£429) and the Creami (£170.99), have been cheaper before, so buy them if they're the right gift, not because they're a bargain. As a rough guide, a KitchenAid Artisan under £400 and a Creami under £150 are strong prices.

Amazon's Black Friday Week runs until Cyber Monday (30 November). Many of the lowest Amazon prices need Prime, so if you don't have it, a [Prime free trial](https://www.amazon.co.uk/amazonprime) covers the sale and Christmas delivery. Cancel before it renews if you don't want it.

## Don't forget the cookbook lover

For someone who reads cookbooks like novels, an [Audible membership](/guides/audible-free-trial-deals-uk/) is a cheap add-on: Audible's Black Friday offer is £0.99 a month for three months until 17 December, and there are plenty of food memoirs and chef biographies to listen to while cooking.

More ideas: [gifts for coffee lovers](/guides/gifts-for-coffee-lovers-uk/), [Le Creuset Black Friday deals](/guides/le-creuset-black-friday-deals-2026/) and the rest of our [Christmas gift guides](/christmas-gifts/).

## FAQs

### What do you buy someone who loves cooking but has everything?

A fast, accurate thermometer like the Thermapen ONE. Even well-equipped home cooks often don't own one, and it improves almost everything they make. A Le Creuset piece in a new colour is the other safe bet.

### What is a good cheap gift for a cook?

The OXO angled measuring jug at £10.99 or the Salter digital scale at £16.99. Both replace tools most people put up with rather than enjoy.

### Is a Le Creuset casserole worth the money?

For someone who cooks stews, braises or bread, yes. It holds heat evenly, goes from hob to oven, and lasts decades. At £186.65 the 24cm size is below the lowest price we'd seen recorded.

### Is the Ninja StaySharp knife block any good?

It's a good-value set for a home cook: the built-in sharpener keeps the edges keen with a quick pull. A keen cook who already has decent knives would get more from a single high-end chef's knife.

### When is the best time to buy kitchen gifts?

This week, if the item is on this list at a low. Prices on cookware and Ninja appliances are at their lowest around Black Friday and Cyber Monday, and often rise again in December.
